article.title: The 6-Workflow AI Back Office: What to Automate Before Hiring a $65,000 Coordinator
article.body_markdown:
Most founders approach AI backward. They open a blank chat window on Monday morning, try two ad-hoc prompts, watch an overhyped "autonomous agent" hallucinate on a simple task, and go right back to answering every email and prepping every client call manually.

90% of growing businesses do not need a complex autonomous agent that needs constant babysitting. They need **six bulletproof back-office automations** that run the same way every time at 10x lower cost.

Instead of shopping for shiny tools, audit every repetitive bottleneck in your week using one rule: **humans stay on judgment, trust, pricing, and final sign-off; owned workflows handle research, intake, first drafts, extraction, and follow-up tracking**.

## Why hiring headcount first makes messy operations heavier

Founders stall between $250K and $5M in revenue because dozens of repeatable micro-processes live unrecorded inside the owner's head:

- Remembering how you respond when a prospect asks for a rush timeline or discount
- Researching every calendar booking ten minutes before Zoom starts
- Turning messy call notes into a clean proposal and action list
- Following up with warm leads five days after a great discovery call

Hiring a $65,000/year junior operations or marketing coordinator before turning those habits into documented workflows rarely removes the bottleneck; now you spend six hours a week reviewing their work. Writing two plain-English context files ([`voice.md` and `icp.md`](https://agenticarchitect.ai/starter-kit)) lets back-office workflows execute 80% of the prep immediately, and makes any Executive Assistant or Ops Manager you already have three times faster.

## The 6 back-office workflows to install first

Here are the six highest-ROI automations we teach non-technical operators inside our [Courses & 6-System Cohort](https://agenticarchitect.ai/courses) and build custom in [Bottleneck Sprints](https://agenticarchitect.ai/work-with-me):

| Back-Office Workflow | Bottleneck Removed | Inputs It Reads | Human Checkpoint (10 Seconds) | Hours Reclaimed / Week |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **1. Company Context Drafter** | Blank-page writing & generic ghostwriters | Your 1-page `voice.md` + 10-min weekly voice memo | Owner reviews & publishes | `4 to 5 hrs` |
| **2. Pre-Call Dossier Pipeline** | Last-minute LinkedIn & website scrambling | New Cal.com booking + company site + `icp.md` | Lands in inbox 30 mins pre-call | `2 to 3 hrs` |
| **3. Draft-First Inbox Triage** | Repetitive FAQ replies & scheduling ping-pong | Inbound Gmail threads + calendar availability | Stages reply in **Gmail Drafts** (never auto-sends) | `3 to 5 hrs` |
| **4. 5-Day Follow-Up Loop** | Warm leads slipping through the cracks | Sent proposals + call notes + CRM/Sheet row | 1-click approve on Day 2 & Day 5 nudges | `2 hrs` |
| **5. Proposal & SOP Extractor** | Rewriting meeting notes into deliverables | Call transcript + approved scope template | Principal checks numbers before sending | `2 to 3 hrs` |
| **6. Software & Spend Watchdog** | Overlapping $30 to $200/mo SaaS creep | Monthly tool usage + [model routing rules](https://agenticarchitect.ai/blog/gemini-4-neon-vs-deepseek-v4) | Monthly summary flag | Saves `$300 to $1,500/mo` |

Notice what **never gets handed to an unreviewed bot**: live discovery calls, pricing decisions, sensitive client relationships, and external send permissions ([Rung 2 on the 5 Levels of AI Autonomy](https://agenticarchitect.ai/blog/the-hitl-standard)).

## Cost & ownership comparison: Hiring vs. Agency vs. Owned Workflows

| Path | Year-1 Cash Cost | Time to First Working Workflow | Who Owns It When Staff Changes? |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Full-Time Junior Ops / Marketing Hire** | `$65,000 to $80,000` + payroll taxes | `90 to 120 days` of recruiting & ramp | Walks out the door when they leave |
| **Black-Box Automation Agency** | `$15,000 to $30,000` + monthly retainer | `6 to 10 weeks` of scoping calls | Contractor owns brittle zaps your staff cannot edit |
| **DIY via Free Live Build & $297 Academy** | `$0 to $297` + existing workspace tools | **This week** (first workflow in 60 mins) | **100% owned inside your accounts** |
| **Guided Cohort or Focused Custom Sprint** | Cohort from `$1,497` · Sprints from `$2,500` | **Week 1 to Day 14** | **100% owned by you + full video SOPs** |

## Three steps to remove your #1 bottleneck this week

1. **Score one repetitive drain in 10 minutes:** List every task you or your team repeated three or more times this week and score the top culprit using our [20/80 Task Readiness Scorecard](https://agenticarchitect.ai/blog/agent-ready-tasks).
2. **Create your 1-page `voice.md` and `icp.md`:** Grab the unlocked templates inside our [free Context Kit](https://agenticarchitect.ai/starter-kit) so every workflow sounds like your company, not generic AI slop.
3. **Pick your speed:** Watch a real workflow wired live in our [Free 60-Minute Prompt-to-System Workshop](https://agenticarchitect.ai/masterclass), go self-paced in our [$297 Workflow Academy](https://agenticarchitect.ai/courses), or book a [Free 20-Minute 1-Bottleneck Discovery Call](https://agenticarchitect.ai/work-with-me).
